sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
COASTAL DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XVII OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act, 1998
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 4th August, 2001]
No. Legis.-2-84(Law)/95, dated
4-8-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
2nd August, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Coastal
Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 5 of Act I of 1998

ORDINANCE XVII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
COASTAL DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XVII OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act, 1998
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 4th August, 2001]
No. Legis.-2-84(Law)/95, dated
4-8-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
2nd August, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 5 of
Act I of 1998.--In the said Act, for subsection (1) of section 5, the
following shall be substituted:--
"(1) The Governing Body
shall consist of the Chairman to be appointed by Government and the following
members:--
(a) Administrative Secretaries of
the following Departments of Government of Balochistan:--
(i) Planning and Development
Department, Additional Chief Secretary (Dev).
(ii) Finance Department.
(iii) Environment, Wildlife,
Livestock, Forest and Tourism Department.
(iv) Agriculture, Cooperative,
Food and Fisheries Department-
(v) Irrigation and Power
Department.
(vi) Education literacy and
Non-Formal Education, Culture Sports and Youth Affairs Department.
(vii) Local Government, Rural
Development and Agrovilles Development Department.
(viii) Public Health Engineering
Department.,
(ix) Communication and Works
Department.
(b) Nazim Gwadar District;
(c) Nazim Lasbela District;
(d) Two Members of the Provincial
Assembly from the Coastal areas to be nominated by the Governor of Balochistan;
(e) Two qualified persons of
repute on Coastal Affairs to be nominated by the Governor of Balochistan:

Amendment of section 6 of Act I of 1998

ORDINANCE XVII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
COASTAL DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XVII OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act, 1998
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 4th August, 2001]
No. Legis.-2-84(Law)/95, dated
4-8-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
2nd August, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
4. Amendment of section 6 of
Act I of 1998.---In the said Act, for section 6 the following shall be
substituted:--
"6. Managing Director.--(1)
The Managing Director shall unless Government otherwise so directs, hold his
office on such terms and conditions as the Government may determine.
(2) The Managing Director on
expiry of his term of office shall be eligible for reappointment for another
term or for such shorter term as Government may determine.
(3) The Managing Director shall
be the Chief Executive Officer of the Authority.
(4) The Managing Director on
authorization by Governing Body shall perform such duties and exercise such
powers as are assigned to them by or under this Act.
(5) When the Managing Director is absent from duty for any
reason or is unable to perform the functions of his office, Governing
Body/Chairman may nominate someone to perform the duties of the Managing
Director."
